decisions.label: M0 TNM Finding
decisions.description: A distant metastasis TNM finding indicating that there is no evidence of distant metastasis.

verification.note: NCIT:C48699 M0 TNM Finding; generic M-category TNM finding. Existing description is accurate but shorter than NCIT definition. Label differs (M0 vs M0 TNM Finding) but is the correct NCIT concept for absence of distant metastasis.

decisions.label: M1 TNM Finding
decisions.description: A clinical and/or pathologic distant metastasis TNM finding indicating the spread of cancer to distant anatomic sites.

verification.note: NCIT:C48700 M1 TNM Finding; generic M-category TNM finding for presence of distant metastasis. Label differs (M1 vs M1 TNM Finding) but is the correct NCIT concept.

decisions.label: M1a TNM Finding
decisions.description: A distant metastasis TNM finding indicating the spread of cancer to a single distant organ or site; the specific meaning varies by cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48701 M1a TNM Finding; generic M1a subcategory. NCIT definition notes that the specific meaning depends on cancer type. Label differs (M1a vs M1a TNM Finding) but is the correct NCIT concept.

decisions.label: M1b TNM Finding
decisions.description: A distant metastasis TNM finding indicating the spread of cancer to multiple distant organs or sites; the specific meaning varies by cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48702 M1b TNM Finding; generic M1b subcategory. The specific meaning depends on cancer type. Label differs (M1b vs M1b TNM Finding) but is the correct NCIT concept.

decisions.label: M1c TNM Finding
decisions.description: A distant metastasis TNM finding indicating the spread of cancer to additional distant anatomic sites; the specific meaning varies by cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48703 M1c TNM Finding; generic M1c subcategory. Specific meaning depends on cancer type. Label differs (M1c vs M1c TNM Finding) but is the correct NCIT concept.

decisions.label: MX TNM Finding
decisions.description: A distant metastasis TNM finding indicating that the status of distant metastasis cannot be assessed.

verification.note: NCIT:C48704 MX TNM Finding; exact concept for unassessable metastasis status. Label differs (MX vs MX TNM Finding) but is the correct NCIT concept.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.

decisions.label: Not Reported
decisions.description: An indication that the required information was not provided.

verification.note: NCIT:C43234 Not Reported; standard NCIT qualifier.
